name: Equital Ltd.
summary: Equital Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the oil and gas sector in Israel and internationally. It operates through Rental of Management of Assets in Israel; Construction of Buildings for Sale in Israel; Oil and Gas in the US; Oil and Gas in Israel; and Other segments. The company is involved in the initiating, locating, planning, developing, constructing, renting, purchasing, providing management and maintenance services, improving, marketing, and selling real estate assets for rent comprising transportation complexes, commercial spaces, office buildings, storage and industrial buildings, parking lots, gas stations, and land.
